discussion_comments.comment_body: fixed in 9f04a4b6. the command list now renders required groups as alternatives, e.g. worktree open (--path PATH | --branch NAME) and pane move (--tab TAB_ID | --new-tab | --new-workspace), and trailing args after -- as [-- <AGENT_ARG>...]. worktree open declares path/branch as one required group so the list and validation share the rule.

registry commands are not remote-forwardable: cli::target::validate_machine_command rejects registry before dispatch. this path only addresses the local selected session, so resolving its relative directory on the caller is intentional. if remote registry commands are added later, they must adopt the existing target::remote_path_is_absolute contract.

discussion_comments.comment_body: `worktree remove` did not accept `--no-focus` before this PR. The removed line belongs to the preceding `worktree open` subcommand; `origin/master`, the CLI parser, and the docs all show remove accepting only `--workspace` and `--force`. Adding `--no-focus` here would create unrelated API surface rather than preserve compatibility.
